detail_seo_title: X-Banner Stands & Custom Printed Graphics | YINZAOSUO
detail_seo_description: Trade supply of X-banner stand hardware, replacement graphics and complete sets. Graphic dimensions must be matched to the selected stand.

detail.lead: An X-banner stand uses crossed support arms to hold a display graphic. It is a portable option for temporary or mobile indoor promotions. Hardware, a separately printed graphic, or a complete set can be supplied.
highlights: Stand hardware can be supplied separately
Replacement printed graphics can be produced separately
Exact dimensions, construction and accessories depend on the selected model
applications: Meetings, training and temporary information displays
finishing: Hardware and graphic supplied as a set
delivery: Hardware and graphics may be packed separately by order
Complete orders follow the confirmed configuration
Packing and freight are assessed by quantity and destination
detail.artwork: Please prepare artwork to the confirmed finished graphic size and allow for the required attachment areas. Basic file checks and minor adjustments can be assisted; extensive changes or original design are confirmed separately.
detail.brief: Please share the intended use, quantity, finished graphic size, whether you need the stand and graphic, a reference model, artwork and destination.
detail.caveat: Support structure, attachment points, graphic dimensions and accessories may vary between X-banner models. Confirm graphic compatibility with the selected stand before production; interchangeability is not assumed.
